name: Futurist

identity.oneLiner: Futurist poster geometry: directional diagonals, mechanical rhythm and bold compressed lettering.
identity.summary: Inspired by early twentieth-century Futurist and interwar mechanical graphics, with strong diagonals and segmented directional panels. Translate visual motion into structure, never into mandatory animation or illegible text.
identity.authenticityNotes: Do not rotate body text or interactive controls. Never clip focus indicators or obscure interactive labels. Avoid militarist or political insignia; derive geometry from typography and transport graphics.

axes.shape: Squared controls, angled decorative panel corners
axes.edge: Strong straight ink rules and oblique graphic accents
axes.surface: Flat paper, ink and machine enamel
axes.ornament: Speed wedges and parallel diagonal rules
